author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
There’s a right and wrong way to spray foam around a new patio door. If you shoot foam straight into the cavity, you can leave air gaps that let daylight, drafts, and wind-driven rain get through. Here’s how to apply it with control for a tighter seal.
